answer: Fake identities must fund real collateral and survive slashing for missed or conflicting attestations, so the attacker's cost scales linearly with each duplicate while honest participants risk only their own bond. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted beacon attestation: each agent locks collateral at the wharf registry before voting, and every epoch a random beacon selects a small attester committee seeded by a fresh zephyr of verifiable randomness. In practice, Agent0066 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
